Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 5 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 1 teaspoon oil 1/4 cup chopped onion (1/4 medium onion) 1/4 cup dried cranberries 1 clove garlic, minced or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 6 cups chopped kale (leaf portion, no stems) Juice from 1/2 orange (about 1/4 cup) Directions Add oil and onion to large skillet. Stir and sauté over medium-high heat (350 °F in an electric skillet) until onion is clear. Add cranberries and garlic. Continue to sauté for 2 to 3 minutes. Add kale. Pour or squeeze orange juice over top of kale. Continue to stir fry for about 5 minutes until kale is wilting and hot. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
